# Hi, I’m David. {#about-heading}

<p class="about-lede">I’m a software engineering student at the University of Waterloo, learning how modern AI systems work by building smaller versions myself. TalkingML is my public notebook for explanations, experiments, and the occasional wrong turn.</p>

## Why TalkingML

I learn better when I have to make an idea clear enough to explain. This site is where I turn rough understanding into something concrete: a small implementation, a diagram, an experiment, or a written note.

<aside class="margin-note" aria-label="Margin note">
  <span class="margin-note-label">Margin note</span>
  <p>This is a notebook, not a victory lap. If an idea changes, the writing can change with it.</p>
</aside>

## What belongs here

- Explanations of machine-learning and AI ideas I am working through.
- Small systems built to understand the larger ones.
- Notes from experiments, including the parts that did not work.

## Elsewhere

For code and current projects, find me on [GitHub](https://github.com/estrindavid). For new TalkingML notes, use the [RSS feed](index.xml).
